Hello my name is John and I live in Georgia. I have a small collection of sarracenia that seems to be ever growing. I purchased some Sarracenia from Mike last weekend and they were shipped quickly and arrived happy and healthy. All plants arrived in a sealed plastic bag, wrapped with care and insulated from the environment, with all roots intact and the pitchers looking picturesque. Mike also included a few bonuses as gifts which was very kind. These sarracenia are going to look amazing next year and I am extremely excited to see them this upcoming Spring. To any newbie buyers like me, I highly recommend Mike, and would say it is absolutely worth starting your collection with some high quality plants like Mike sells.

I took some pictures of the S. Minor var. Oke, and S. Minor var minor I received and hope these aid your decision to purchase

I've been buying Sarracenia from Mike off and on for at least a decade now. What I love most is that he is not only a phenomenal Sarracenia grower, he is an excellent photographer as well. This is why I first decided to purchase from him, and why I still do.

Not only are his select clones more varied than a lot of other lists, but being able to see examples of them in various stages of growth is what usually closes the sale for me. Granted, he has added a lot of new clones recently without pictures, but I'm sure they will pop up at some point in the pics pages of these boards. And as a grower who doesn't have one hybrid in his collection, I also appreciate his focus on species.

The plants always arrive very fast, very healthy, and much larger than what I expected. Mike has made a name for himself in the Sarracenia community and it is well-deserved!

Thanks, Mike for all you do! (And thanks to the Sarracenia Proboards for hosting his list and pictures as well.)
